reservoir_ep14_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_001.text: The low practice pavilion smelled of damp wood on One Thousand One Hundred Eighty. Yue arrived with the actual travel report and no borrowed apparatus from home. Jing prepared the accepted blank before touching the personal sample. Mei read the current sleep and ordinary fatigue account, then checked that the comparison's purpose was a recovered starting state rather than another changed-condition attempt. Deng kept his own stool near the low mat. The room was ready to receive the body that had returned, without asking the journey to have improved it.

reservoir_ep14_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_002.text: The actually usable starting reserve after current rest and morning movement measured sixty-nine and three quarters before sampling. The quarter-unit sample left sixty-nine and a half, with ninety-one and a half percent compatibility. Both remained below this board's stage-eight thresholds. Yue had expected some variation after the ordinary road and felt relieved to see a present answer instead of a remembered quantity she had to defend. The sample was actually gone. It could guide renewed safe practice while leaving the usable inventory smaller than the starting comparison.

reservoir_ep14_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_003.text: Mei examined the interruption edge and found the familiar uneven response still present. The family journey had completed ordinary human purposes; it had not supplied a physiological certificate. Yue described the current pause honestly and asked which safe practice could address its timing. Deng retained the already-earned input ceiling and proposed modest sets separated by full grounding. No new anatomy, range or load belonged to that proposal. The lower reservoir remained the familiar site they had actually assessed. An attractive explanation about a second hidden center would not improve its present trace.

reservoir_ep14_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_004.text: A traveling teacher had left a leaflet at the public gate promising to awaken an upper reservoir through sleepless practice. Qiu brought it only because candidates had begun discussing it, not as an accepted course method. Deng asked which qualified current test supported its bodily claim. The leaflet offered testimonials and a pleasing diagram. Mei's registered examination did not extend to the proposed method. Yue folded the page and returned it to the public receiving shelf. Her failed sleep response was not a reason to purchase more sleeplessness from an untested promise.

reservoir_ep14_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_005.text: The pump candidate liked the diagram and asked whether rejecting it meant they lacked imagination. Yue said imagination could help ask a question without supplying its measured answer. Deng agreed and pointed to the ordinary familiar pause they could already observe. The candidate grew irritated because the known fault looked less exciting than the hidden center. Yue understood that wish. They returned to their separate safe mats. Nobody had to declare every unseen possibility impossible before refusing to put an untested anatomy claim into today's paid practice.

reservoir_ep14_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_006.text: Deng supervised the first modest safe sets after travel with explicit full releases between them. Each ordinary breath stayed at or below an eighth unit of input, and the familiar four-breath set never exceeded half. Yue did not convert the recorded gross input into usable inventory. She stopped after the agreed finite lesson, with the present sample result still describing its own earlier time. A later independent comparison would measure what actually remained after practice, work, discharge and rest. Waiting for that answer had begun to feel like part of control rather than an insult to it.

reservoir_ep14_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_007.text: At lunch Jing complained that somebody had borrowed the ordinary preparation towel to dry a flower pot. The borrower admitted it and returned it for proper cleaning. The pot itself was unharmed, and no personal sample had been taken with the misused towel. Jing accepted the actual correction and kept the next preparation separate until its materials were checked. Yue liked the difference between preventing a bad measurement and pretending the borrowed object had never left. The room could remain accurate through ordinary mistakes when people named their actual uses.

reservoir_ep14_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_008.text: Fu met Yue at the kitchen table and asked whether the current comparison had been difficult to hear. Yue said it had been disappointingly reasonable. Fu declared that a useful phrase and wanted to borrow it for her brother's explanation of the crooked boot knot. They discussed the home visit only in the ordinary details Yue wished to share. The new shelf belonged to the mother, the song scrap belonged to its giver and the examination belonged to its independent record. A meal could hold all those relationships without making one person the receiver of every explanation.

reservoir_ep14_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_009.text: On One Thousand One Hundred Eighty-one, Deng used a plain wooden cup to practice the pause before a safe stop. He moved it within the low familiar field while Yue kept the earned circuit grounded between modest sets. She noticed the movement without chasing it. At the agreed signal she released fully, then described the cup's actual position. The lesson addressed attention through a simple physical change. It did not become a passed qualifying movement trial because the cup had behaved politely and the room remained comfortable.

reservoir_ep14_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_010.text: The cup slipped from Deng's ordinary hand during the next discussion and fell onto the mat. It was empty and caused no danger. Yue's arm started toward it, then remained within comfortable reach when she saw there was nothing to rescue. Deng retrieved it himself and admitted his hand had been clumsy. His qualified role did not make every movement exact. The admission helped Yue separate a useful teacher from a flawless person. They checked the cup's condition before using it again and ended the lesson at its finite boundary.

reservoir_ep14_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_011.text: Jing's father invited her to taste beans from two ordinary garden rows on Eighty-two. One row had grown in wetter soil and tasted less sweet, though both were sound food. He wanted to blame the season, but Jing wanted him to compare the actual preparation before deciding. They cooked the next small bowls the same way and found a modest difference remained. Yue attended as an ordinary guest. No sample of her reservoir entered the bowls. She enjoyed seeing a careful question survive beyond the pavilion without becoming another demand upon her body.

reservoir_ep14_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_012.text: That evening Yue wrote a short private note about the present safe-input assessment for her own use. She did not send a new examination report to the mother immediately after the recent safe-return acknowledgment. The household could continue ordinary days without receiving every fraction as urgent news. Yue drew the low shelf beside the river onion instead. The drawing was poor enough to make Tian laugh when she later chose to show it. A present reserve quantity could matter deeply without acquiring every conversation in which she might otherwise be human.

reservoir_ep14_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_013.text: On Eighty-three, Zhou confirmed the next shared ordinary duty for Eighty-four. Its work would remain low-table receiving and actual source comparison in two four-hour intervals. Heavy carrying belonged to the qualified ordinary workers. Yue reported comfortable shoulder condition and no headache, with her post-road fatigue eased. The retained examination ceiling did not change the job's demand. Zhou asked whether she wanted to explain the plateau lesson to a new clerk during the accepted work, and she agreed to describe only its permitted public source distinction.

reservoir_ep14_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_014.text: The morning interval on Eighty-four began with three incoming dry measures and a source list whose copied totals matched. Yue asked the new clerk to check actual dates and owners separately. One measure had been returned by a neighboring household on a different day than the copy showed. The owner confirmed the supported correction through the ordinary process. Yue did not claim attendance at any event she had missed; today's actual owner answer supplied today's source. The new clerk saw how a correct total could sit beside an incorrect interval without announcing its own flaw.

reservoir_ep14_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_015.text: During the afternoon's four-hour interval, Yue and the clerk checked the remaining supported sources against the actual receiving marks. The corrected date affected a storage interval through its ordinary account, not the candidate wage line. Zhou accepted the completed eight-hour equivalent and paid three actual coppers from the course allocation. This was the first of the twenty-five shared ordinary days remaining after the family calendars. The earlier selected duties had already been settled with their actual worker. Today's payment belonged to Yue because she had done today's accepted work.

reservoir_ep14_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_016.text: Tian offered to paint a smaller fish on the new clerk's board. The clerk requested no fish at all until he understood where each date belonged. Tian looked personally wounded for a moment and then accepted the useful condition. Yue asked whether the basket wanted to file a formal artistic complaint. Tian said it had discovered the value of a quiet life. The clerk laughed, and the three ate their ordinary lunch after the source checks were complete. A joke could help a worker belong without obscuring the very board they had taught him to read.

reservoir_ep14_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_017.text: On Eighty-five Deng kept Yue's practice demand modest after the ordinary work day. She reported actual low fatigue and remained within the comfortable known range. They practiced a familiar release before and after an ordinary spoken question. Yue answered the question about yesterday's corrected owner, then stopped at the registered cue. She had begun hearing another person's words without immediately turning them into an interruption to defeat. Deng noted the useful teaching response. Mei would later compare the harder registered conditions independently instead of certifying this comfortable lesson from his approval.

reservoir_ep14_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_018.text: Jing prepared the accepted comparison on Eighty-six. The actually usable inventory after sleep and morning activity measured seventy and a quarter before the quarter-unit sample. Seventy remained usable afterward, with ninety-one and three quarters percent compatibility. Recorded modest safe intake and real recovered practice supplied its current change; no lost road quantity had been magically returned. The quantity still fell below seventy-two. Yue could see a steadier interruption edge within the comparison's present limits and asked Jing to preserve that observation without calling it a passed changed condition.

reservoir_ep14_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_019.text: The pump candidate had received a lower current result and wanted to know whether Yue's increase proved she had chosen the better home date. She refused the comparison. Their bodies, practices, work and travel conditions had been different, and her own visit had answered ordinary family purposes. A present reserve result could not assign moral value to either household calendar. He considered that and apologized for trying to make her number a judgment about his delay. They took an ordinary walk and discussed the cat, whose latest stolen fish remained an unambiguous household problem.

reservoir_ep14_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_020.text: On Eighty-seven Fu asked Yue to join the garden meal after the next work interval if comfortable. A new household water disagreement had begun beyond the lower bank, but tonight's invitation involved no record collection. Yue accepted the ordinary meal and asked which vegetables should be brought from the public seller. Fu wanted onions at the actual market price, paid from her own prepared food money. Yue could carry the light purchase within ordinary reach and return the change. The small errand had an actual owner, cost and end before anybody talked about basin policy.

reservoir_ep14_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_021.text: At the seller's stall a boy tried to persuade her to buy an enormous squash. He claimed it would improve every soup for a month. Yue said one of her friends would regard that as a threat. The seller laughed and gave her the requested onions at their ordinary posted price. Yue returned the actual change to Fu and reported the squash proposal. Fu threatened to tell the squash-hating candidate. Their later meal remained ordinary food from its hosts, with no secret candidate material account filling the basket.

reservoir_ep14_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_022.text: Eighty-eight brought a cool morning, but the modest lesson remained familiar. Deng asked Yue to notice the neck tension that arrived before she tried to resist the cool air. She settled, released and used the ordinary coat already within reach. Adding a warm layer could reduce discomfort without certifying a temperature response. The actual changed-condition trial would later record its own mild targets, usable costs and independent follow-up. Yue liked having an ordinary useful action available today that did not need to pretend it had completed the larger examination.

reservoir_ep14_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_023.text: Zhou's next accepted ordinary duty fell on Eighty-nine. The morning four-hour interval concerned empty measures returned from a public kitchen. One handle had loosened, and the kitchen receiver had marked it as sound because the bowl still held the expected volume. Yue asked the receiver to distinguish volume from carrying condition. The handle returned to ordinary repair before another worker used it. The bowl's correct capacity remained recorded, but it did not make the damaged handle safe. The new clerk recognized the analogy without Yue turning it into another speech.

reservoir_ep14_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_024.text: The afternoon interval completed the actual low-table work and supported condition notices. Zhou accepted the eight-hour equivalent and paid three coppers, the second of the remaining twenty-five shared days. The bowl's repair cost belonged to its ordinary owner arrangement, not Yue's course wage. She could be useful through accurate receiving without possessing a new physical capability. At supper she told Tian that his basket had finally gained a respectable relative: a bowl with an ambitious handle. Tian declined to let the basket associate with unreliable lifting equipment.

reservoir_ep14_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_025.text: On Ninety Qiu asked whether Yue wanted to hear the new water disagreement at its later public receiving hour. The households had not yet consented to every proposed comparison, so attendance would begin with their actual stated issues rather than a file taken for granted. Yue accepted the invitation within her free time and current ordinary scope. No closed city endorsement returned with it. The basin's current process could receive a visitor who asked particular permitted questions and left private household details where their owners had kept them.

reservoir_ep14_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_026.text: Before that hour Fu warned Yue that one receiver was angry about a child missing sleep. Yue remembered how easily she had treated a failed interrupted night as an isolated practice fault. A household calendar could produce the interruption repeatedly, with ordinary work the next day. Listening would require more than a reserve threshold. She wrote no conclusion before meeting the household. Her earned small circuit gave her no authority over their beds, water turns or wage days. She could bring attention and ask what actual comparison they would consent to.

reservoir_ep14_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_027.text: At the public hour the first receiver described a proposed extra evening draw. A second receiver said the change would overlap a cleaning interval near the shared path. Qiu recorded the disagreement and asked each household to confirm its own current source before comparing future plans. Yue listened to the actual voices without assuming the east and west rows from the earlier plateau session described these different homes. The same kind of copied timing error might be possible; it had not yet been proved here. Familiarity could guide a question while evidence still had to arrive.

reservoir_ep14_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_028.text: The households agreed to show their current aggregate intervals at a later meeting, reserving private work and sleep details until each owner chose its scope. Qiu set no water policy that afternoon. Yue left with a particular unanswered question about the cleaning overlap and an ordinary reminder of how many people a convenient schedule could miss. The disagreement would belong to the coming days. Her current practice still required its modest safe sets and independent measurements. She walked back by the dry public path before the familiar shoulder became tired.

reservoir_ep14_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_029.text: On Ninety-one Deng asked Yue to repeat the difference between an application ceiling and a reservoir certification. She described the unchanged maximum eighth-unit breath and half-unit familiar four-breath total, then the later balance criteria. A storage certificate would not clear a new load, range or anatomy. Deng accepted the answer and asked her to apply the familiar low task. She completed it within the old measured useful quarter-unit output and released fully. The lesson remained a safe observed practice, with its actual costs and no automatic new skill attached.

reservoir_ep14_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_030.text: That evening Yue sat beside the kitchen window and listened to ordinary rain. She had worked two more real days, returned to measured safe practice and heard the beginning of a different household disagreement. The mother remained at home with her own completed shelf and chosen helper. Yue did not need a new reply to permit the next morning. She turned the river-creature drawing so its ears faced the room and imagined it listening badly. Then she put the joke away and slept before the noisy cart arrived.

reservoir_ep14_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_031.text: On One Thousand One Hundred Ninety-two, the public bank path reopened after the rain under its ordinary attendant's current check. Yue walked it slowly with Jing and saw the loose reed tapping again. She had missed that uneven sound during the road. Jing said an irritation could become familiar enough to resemble a welcome. They disagreed about whether that was good for a person. Neither tried to settle the question with a sample sleeve. The path ended at the same public bench, where they sat and discussed beans.

reservoir_ep14_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_032.text: Jing had begun noticing her father's fatigue after long garden visits. He still wanted to describe every row, but now accepted a chair halfway through. Yue asked whether he wanted the others to mention it. Jing had asked him, and he preferred a chair placed without commentary. They talked about how ordinary care could follow somebody's preference instead of making each pause visible as a lesson. The mother had also chosen the shelf herself. Yue carried the resemblance quietly, without announcing that two different people's limits proved one general rule.

reservoir_ep14_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_033.text: The next modest lesson practiced attending to an ordinary instruction while holding no application load. Deng asked Yue to describe a low marker's change before beginning intake, then stopped her when she answered the question she expected rather than the one he had asked. They laughed at the mistake and returned to the actual wording. His qualified patience did not make the finite paid session unlimited. Yue completed the agreed smaller task and left while she remained attentive. The useful change began in hearing, before any more input entered the body.

reservoir_ep14_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_034.text: On Ninety-three, Jing's independent current comparison began with an accepted blank and the ordinary recovered condition. Seventy-one measured usable before sampling, leaving seventy and three quarters after the actual quarter-unit sample. Compatibility measured ninety-one and seven eighths percent. The qualified safe sets had supplied recorded modest input between comparisons. The present gain remained below the quantity threshold, and the failed changed conditions still needed their later recovered series. Yue looked at the result and chose not to round either fractional gap out of the day.

reservoir_ep14_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_035.text: Tian asked whether a seven-eighths fraction was deliberately invented to make handwriting difficult. Yue said the actual comparison was indifferent to his pen. He practiced writing it on scrap and made the loop too large. Jing showed him a clearer ordinary mark without letting him near the prepared sample record. The little clerical lesson belonged to a different task than the independent instrument comparison. Yue liked watching him learn a fraction that described her disappointment without being asked to cheer her up about it. Accurate company could be warm.

reservoir_ep14_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_036.text: On Ninety-four, Yue began the third shared ordinary duty after the family calendars. The morning four-hour interval checked public kitchen measures whose returned conditions had been confirmed by their actual owners. The repaired loose handle had passed ordinary receiving inspection and could return to use. Yue repeated the physical condition check rather than treating its repaired label as sufficient. A nearby rim had acquired a small splinter. It went to the proper ordinary shelf before another worker handled it, with its actual capacity still distinguished from its grip condition.

reservoir_ep14_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_037.text: At midday Zhou told the new clerk to take an ordinary break even though one copied list remained unfinished. The clerk wanted to prove he could finish without stopping. Yue recognized the desire too well to mock it. She said the list would remain on the low table and the source receiver would not arrive until afternoon. He ate with them and returned less hurried. The accepted eight-hour equivalent included the actual work intervals and appropriate ordinary pacing, not a spectacle of whoever could ignore hunger most persuasively.

reservoir_ep14_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_038.text: The afternoon's supported source checks completed the duty. Zhou accepted its actual eight-hour equivalent and paid three coppers from the course line. Three of the remaining twenty-five shared duties had now been performed and paid, nine coppers in all. The source corrections changed ordinary equipment use through their own receivers rather than alter an examination number. Yue put the payment into personal money outside the closed family travel account. She would need ordinary food after the finite course eventually ended, whichever new basin agreement she later chose.

reservoir_ep14_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_039.text: Fu found the new clerk sitting beside the garden with an apple and asked whether he wanted company. He said he wanted to eat it before Tian offered to draw a fish on it. Fu promised protection from unsolicited fruit art. Yue joined them briefly and described the mother laughing at the river creature. The clerk had not met the mother and asked whether she liked ridiculous pictures generally. Yue said she liked particular ones and often said exactly why she disliked others. They laughed and left the apple unpainted.

reservoir_ep14_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_040.text: On Ninety-five, Qiu posted the next household receiving meeting for the later water disagreement. Its first purpose was to verify the current aggregate intervals each owner had consented to show. No private household work detail would be assumed from the total alone. Yue read the date and left her question for that actual meeting. She had begun recognizing how anticipation could fill a blank with the most convenient imagined source. The board's unanswered space deserved to remain unanswered until the receiver who held the information arrived.

reservoir_ep14_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_041.text: Deng's modest lesson that afternoon used a familiar low turn after full grounding, with no new load. Yue noticed an ordinary environmental change when a window opened but retained the planned pause. The lesson showed useful timing under its present condition. Deng recorded it without calling it the registered changed-temperature trial. He asked how her attention had differed from the first failed warm response. Yue said she had noticed the window as something in the room instead of treating it as a threat to the number she wanted. The distinction could now be practiced.

reservoir_ep14_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_042.text: Afterward she went to the public bench with the candidate who disliked squash. The woman had received a letter reporting that her family's kitchen now served squash twice weekly because a neighbor had a surplus. She considered this a betrayal of the calendar. Yue asked whether the neighbor's supply had a finite end. Apparently nobody knew. They composed an extremely polite request for onions and then decided not to send it. The candidate would answer her family about more important actual news first, keeping the vegetable protest as a private joke.

reservoir_ep14_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_043.text: On Ninety-six the garden's oldest bean support leaned in the wind. Jing's father wanted to straighten it immediately, but the ordinary wet ground made its footing unreliable. Fu's brother offered to do the task after the actual dry-ground check the following morning. The father grumbled and accepted the wait. Yue remained on the sound path with Jing. Nobody needed a cultivator's untested long reach to make a harmless garden delay more impressive. The beans would endure one crooked night, and the actual ordinary repair could happen when its footing was safe.

reservoir_ep14_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_044.text: That evening Yue read the old temperature failure once for a particular question. The trace had narrowed while she watched its edge too intently. She wanted to ask Deng how to preserve attention to the room without ignoring a useful instrument. The answer would concern the safe familiar practice he could teach, not a promise the next condition would pass. She wrote the question, put the trace away and ate supper. Her current life was larger than the failed page, which made returning to its specific evidence easier rather than less necessary.

reservoir_ep14_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_045.text: On Ninety-seven the ordinary ground check permitted Fu's brother to straighten the bean support. He completed the physical task with Jing's father's chosen ordinary materials, within their own garden arrangement. Yue watched the father inspect it and declare the angle insufficiently elegant but structurally acceptable. Fu's brother bowed extravagantly to the distinction. The garden's comedy survived beside its practical safety. Yue would have missed it if she had spent the morning trying to recreate yesterday's failed trace in an unqualified corner of the practice court.

reservoir_ep14_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_046.text: Deng answered her instrument-attention question by separating observation moments from active demand. Within the familiar safe lesson, Yue first looked at the low empty comparison cup and described it, then grounded before beginning the finite input set. At the agreed stop she released fully before looking again. Jing's actual instrument comparison would still follow its registered method. Deng's ordinary cup exercise could improve attention without pretending the candidate herself had become an independent examiner. Yue practiced the separation and found the silence after release less urgent.

reservoir_ep14_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_047.text: On Ninety-eight Qiu told Yue that the later water disagreement now had verified current aggregate sources. The Liang household received twelve litres at each of two daily intervals; the Ren household received twenty-four at one. Equal daily totals did not imply interchangeable times, because the shared cleaning interval and actual collection work differed. Both households had consented to discuss these current marks publicly. Future household testimony about sleep remained each owner's choice. Yue read the accepted preparation and kept her questions about the specific overlap rather than import the earlier east-west story wholesale.

reservoir_ep14_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_048.text: Fu knew one of the receivers and warned Yue that the public summary would not explain the whole quarrel. The people had argued before the present draw proposal. Yue said she would ask about the current source first and avoid diagnosing every old relationship. Fu approved that modest beginning. They bought ordinary onions for the next garden meal and left the enormous squash with its optimistic seller. Yue had heard enough household stories to know that a convenient technical explanation could become another way of refusing to hear what a person was actually saying.

reservoir_ep14_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_049.text: One Thousand One Hundred Ninety-nine was the fourth shared ordinary duty day after the visits. The first four-hour interval handled supported storage notices for the public kitchen's repaired measures. A notice used the condition-check date as its actual return date. Yue asked the receiver to distinguish the two. The object had returned earlier and waited for inspection before reuse. Both events mattered, with different ordinary consequences. Tian copied their supported dates separately and left room for the new clerk to repeat the source check without guessing which mark meant what.

reservoir_ep14_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_050.text: The afternoon's four-hour interval completed the actual related checks. Zhou accepted the eight-hour equivalent and paid three coppers. The four shared duties on Eighty-four, Eighty-nine, Ninety-four and Ninety-nine had now actually paid twelve. Remaining wages stayed allocated for later performed work. Yue wanted no payment for the interesting receiving conversation alone, nor a second wage because its correction might prevent future trouble. The finite funded duties had bought real low-table work that day. Its accurate result would remain useful when somebody else picked up the board tomorrow.

reservoir_ep14_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_051.text: At supper Tian unveiled a drawing of the basket wearing a clerk's hat. The new clerk said its date handwriting remained poor. Yue suggested a course of ordinary practice before promotion. Jing accused all three of becoming unbearably procedural about a picture. They laughed and let the basket retire from the imaginary appointment. The drawing went beside the river creature, where two absurd objects could exist without another accurate source mark. Yue ate the beans and noticed her appetite had returned to an ordinary pleasure rather than a recovery observation she had to manage.

reservoir_ep14_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_052.text: On Day One Thousand Two Hundred, the actual recovered comparison measured seventy-one and three quarters usable before its quarter-unit sample. Seventy-one and a half remained afterward, with ninety-one and seven eighths percent compatibility. The present qualified practice had supplied recorded safe input while actual work and rest belonged to the measured condition. The quantity still fell below the local seventy-two requirement. The changed-temperature, movement and sleep responses still required a later registered recovered series with actual next-day checks. Yue could see improvement without pretending the last half-unit gap was already gone.

reservoir_ep14_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_053.text: Mei asked whether Yue wanted to register the later qualifying sequence now. Yue agreed to preserve its intended dates subject to actual recovery and qualified starting checks, rather than promise her body would be ready because the room had space. The independent examiner's fixed fee remained the same whether those later attempts passed or failed. Actual qualification would require the three completed changed-condition trials and their next mornings. Yue wrote the plan on her private calendar and felt hope arrive in a useful bounded form instead of as a demand upon everyone else's confidence.

reservoir_ep14_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_054.text: Deng retained modest already-earned instruction between now and that series. The physical input ceiling remained unchanged. He wanted a body able to stop and attend under changed conditions before it carried any certificate describing a balanced reservoir. Yue wanted that too, though she still wanted the certificate itself. They did not pretend the desires were identical. The recognized stage could open later qualified opportunities. The measured useful control would have to survive the actual life in which she took them. Today's lesson ended after a sound familiar release, with no new range appended.

reservoir_ep14_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_055.text: Qiu asked Yue to help set out low chairs for the next day's household receiving discussion, if her ordinary condition remained comfortable. The task was light and finite, not a new paid eight-hour duty. Yue accepted the ordinary shared preparation and left the heavier bench to the assigned worker. The Liang and Ren receivers would choose what testimony to offer tomorrow. She had a particular unanswered question and a place from which to hear it. No cultivation title would make either household's bed, water or wages hers to rearrange.

reservoir_ep14_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_056.text: Fu came to inspect the chair arrangement and asked whether the two receivers would face each other or the actual source board. Qiu chose the board first, with room to turn toward one another afterward. Yue liked the practical staging of a difficult conversation. A quarrel could become louder when its people watched each other's expressions before agreeing what the page said. The chairs might help them see the current marks together. They would not erase the old disagreement, and nobody pretended furniture could supply consent the households had not yet given.

reservoir_ep14_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_057.text: At the garden meal that evening, Jing's father asked whether the reservoir had finally balanced. Yue said the present net quantity was seventy-one and a half and the harder conditions remained unpassed. He nodded, then asked whether she wanted more beans. She did. The question made her think of the mother's first greeting and smile without explaining the resemblance. Ordinary people could hear an unfinished result and still offer supper. She would bring her actual present body to the next lesson, and her ordinary listening to the household discussion tomorrow.

reservoir_ep14_058.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_058.text: Before bed she checked that the next ordinary wage duties fell on Two Hundred Four, Nine and Fourteen, outside the receiving discussion's actual short hours. The course allocation would pay them after performed eight-hour equivalents, and the household conversation would have its own finite current process. Yue did not let a useful invitation swallow days already accepted for work. She placed the three dates beside the later qualifying plan, kept the family visit account closed and turned the lamp down with its low ordinary cord.

reservoir_ep14_059.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_059.text: The basin outside reflected a cloudless patch of sky until a wind broke it into several pale shapes. Yue had begun understanding the reservoir as a balance that needed to survive movement rather than remain impressive while protected from it. The image was useful and still only an image. Her actual body had measured quantities and observed response faults that would require more recovered practice. She watched the light change, then left the window. Sleep belonged to tonight's ordinary recovery, not an occasion she could rehearse into tomorrow's success.

reservoir_ep14_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_060.text: In the dark she remembered her mother moving the cup inward on the completed low shelf. The correction had been small, owned and practical. Yue could make similarly specific changes here: hear the real question, stop the actual sequence, count the withdrawn sample, ask before taking a household's time. None would restore the old lost years. Together they could shape the ordinary days still available. She settled the earned small circuit and slept, ready to meet a public dispute whose people would matter beyond whatever she learned from their records.

reservoir_ep14_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_061.text: At dawn on One Thousand Two Hundred One, the Liang receiver arrived early with an adult daughter who looked tired. The daughter had agreed to attend the public hour, not to have her employer's private schedule copied onto the basin board. Yue heard that distinction before either woman approached the chairs. Qiu welcomed them and asked which current aggregate marks each would consent to show. The tired woman kept her own pay paper folded. Its presence in her hand did not make its contents a shared source.

reservoir_ep14_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_062.text: The Ren receiver came next carrying a clean ordinary bucket. She had brought it to demonstrate the actual collection work, not surrender it to an institution. A gate worker tried to take it toward the storage shelf, assuming every arriving object needed receiving. She objected sharply. Yue pointed to the public meeting chairs and waited while Qiu confirmed the visitor's intended use. The bucket remained with its owner. An apparently helpful mistake had briefly made the receiving process look like a claim nobody had agreed to grant.

reservoir_ep14_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_063.text: The two receivers greeted each other stiffly. Their present aggregate water totals were equal, but the Liang daughter said equal water did not mean equal waking hours. The Ren receiver replied that her cleaning work also needed a real interval. Qiu asked them to begin with their actual current marks before assigning motives. Yue felt the room tighten around the word 'equal.' She would need to hear what each woman meant by it, rather than congratulate herself because both totals added to twenty-four.

reservoir_ep14_064.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_064.text: Tian brought the current public source board and placed it where both receivers could see the dates. His small fish remained beneath the writing area. The Liang daughter noticed it and smiled once, then returned to the paper she kept private. Yue appreciated the brief human change without using the smile as proof that the disagreement had softened. Each household still had a particular ordinary need. A good meeting would have to make room for those needs without taking private work records simply because they were useful.

reservoir_ep14_065.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep14_065.text: Before the first source was read aloud, Yue moved her own question sheet away from the empty copying space. She would record only the public facts and testimony their actual owners offered. The rest could remain unknown. Her present reserve and unfinished certificate had no place in deciding whose sleep or cleaning interval mattered. Qiu invited the Liang receiver to begin in her own words, and the room turned toward the current dated marks.
